acceptance: Original CS8.STT3: paired 95% interval contains 0 in every language AND zero silent tail drops across every required pause case for every required configuration; no unknown, VOID or incomplete case establishes PASS. Collection completeness is not parity.

decode.threshold_difference: transcribe compression ratio and reference/Crisp entropy have different meanings; log native defaults, do not claim equivalence

execution: CPU correctness normal calendar build-role grant; dynamic keeper CPUs; 24 threads only when actually granted; R11 smoke two SMT threads <=8GiB <=300s beside non-timing; immutable per-cell exposures, no redraw, strict native-byte resume, rc75 plus partial at cutoff, verified captured-process cleanup; retain prior unrelated JFK diagnostics separately.
prompt: This is a transcription of spoken audio.

scoring.interval: 95% percentile candidate-minus-reference pooled WER difference, percentage points
scoring.known_decode_failure: empty hypothesis, full reference deletions, retained in denominator
scoring.methods: canonical score_utterance plus paired_bootstrap_delta over complete matched error/reference arrays, canonical in-run contract/property checks
scoring.seed_derivation: unsigned integer of first 8 hex SHA256(campaign UTF-8)
scoring.token_identity: literal actual-generated text IDs 0<=id<50257, same universe for every arm; concatenate chunks by original index; retain all-native IDs separately, no retokenization substitute
scoring.uncertainty_summary: 95% interval half-width in percentage points: (upper-lower)/2; this is not an A/A instrument floor
scoring.unknown_or_void: retain immutable exposure; no redraw; cannot establish PASS

segmentation.before_asr: derived shared manifest pins this plan and original source inputs, raw native VAD and producer catalog; ASR launcher pins that manifest digest before first ASR
segmentation.policy: latest native Silero speech end within each 480000-sample window; exact contiguous original PCM cover; no boundary is VOID; no replacement

source_contract: Final launcher embeds expected source-catalog SHA before checking members; catalog pins this plan, actual job/readers/native model and library bytes and derived chunk manifest before ASR. Engineering corrections may create a new immutable source catalog before exposure, retaining prior source and controls; scientific methods/inputs/gate stay fixed. No additional admission receipt or human review prerequisite.

tail_oracle.method: reviewed conservative canonical v1 independent normalization/alignment; full suffix deletion with observed prefix and original endpoint at/before pause is SILENT_TAIL_DROP; no suffix deletions plus exact tail match and endpoint beyond pause is TAIL_OBSERVED; ambiguity, partial deletion, uncheckable timing/text or decode status are UNKNOWN
tail_oracle.timing: map VAD-compressed spans back to original timeline; ambiguous mapping UNKNOWN
